compared.difference: Old primary is the linearized density/scattering theorem; it removes the quadratic interaction [w*rho_Q,Q]. The target retains this interaction and proves global nonlinear control uniform in hbar.
The two uniform response-kernel integrals are included uncounted support. Nonlinear quantum energy cancellation and all other bootstrap closures remain additional work.
Penrose is a hypothesis here; this target does not count another sufficient linear-stability criterion.

The original classical screened Vlasov mechanism is credited. The target is the quantum Hartree equation with the hbar-weighted density derivative and constants uniform in the semiclassical parameter.
